_description: Model registry — tracks all model artifacts, versions, and training metadata

rice_gate.notes: Existing gate behavior is retained for regression compatibility. Its Logistic Regression artifact was trained on generated feature vectors, not a real labeled image corpus; reported confidence is experimental and uncalibrated.

segmentation.notes: No Mask R-CNN checkpoint/local instance annotations. GrainSet single-kernel masks may need adaptation for bulk scenes; classical CV fallback remains active.

chalky.notes: Disabled for prediction: prior artifacts were fit to synthetic feature vectors, not labeled grain images.

damaged.notes: Experimental only: checkpoint trained on generated illustrations, not labeled rice-grain images; classes do not distinguish slightly damaged grains.

foreign_matter.notes: YOLO11n taxonomy configured, but no local image annotations or checkpoint are available; source class coverage is unverified and classical CV fallback is active.

sprouted_weevilled.notes: Experimental inference only. Existing checkpoint was trained and tested on generated crops; metrics do not establish performance on rice images.
